To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the increasing trend in the use of plastic packaged bottled water in Ethiopia demands for application of reverse logistics of water bottling companies for recycling of plastic packaged water products for environmental sustainability.
reverse logistics of bottled water manufacturing companies is not practiced in Ethiopia and the plastic packages of bottled waters are dumped in the streets and other public places.

(i) there is a growing trend in the use of bottled water in Addis Abba, (ii) the trend in bottled water consumption is not only for home and office use, but also for recreational and tourism purposes, (iii) bottled water consumption in Addis Abab is growing faster than in the other regions of Ethiopia, and (iv) the trend of bottled water consumption in Ethiopia is increasing faster than its supply.
